crossRefs.note: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
translations.bsb: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
translations.kjv: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
translations.asv: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
